title: Fix compute(a, b) in src/main.py to return the product of two finite numeric inputs
description: The function compute(a, b) in src/main.py currently returns None instead of the product of its two inputs. Required behavior: compute(a, b) must return the product of two finite numeric inputs. Example: compute(2, 3) must return 6. Must support zero, negative, and fractional values (e.g., compute(0, 5) == 0, compute(-2, 3) == -6, compute(2.5, 4) == 10.0). Reproduce the failure before editing, then fix src/main.py and verify with checks/public_check.py and bytecode compilation of src.
